_doc: Commands that MUST exist at their DECLARED path after `build.sh switch`. The verifier checks the path itself (the old `command -v` fallback let stale imperative files satisfy the check — removed 2026-08-08). claude-malloc/-rescue/-termux moved to ~/.local/bin paths: they are extracted there at runtime by the my-ai binary (da_my-ai scripts_assets), NOT installed by this flake.

commands.name: claude
commands.fix: Installed by flake.nix via pkgs.callPackage ./pkgs/claude-code (native binary, pinned version+hash in that file). If missing, the derivation didn't build — check the build log for claude-code errors.

commands.name: claude-malloc
commands.fix: Extracted to ~/.local/bin at runtime by the my-ai binary (da_my-ai core/src/scripts_assets.rs) — run `my-ai` once.

commands.name: claude-rescue
commands.fix: Extracted by the my-ai binary — run `my-ai` once.

commands.name: claude-termux
commands.fix: Extracted by the my-ai binary — run `my-ai` once.

commands.name: cloud-ide-sshd
commands.fix: Installed by cloud-ide-sshd module via home.file. If missing, the flake didn't activate — re-run build.sh switch.

commands.name: sshd
commands.fix: Installed by modules/cloud-ide-sshd/default.nix via home.packages (stock pkgs.openssh — the 8.9p1 pin was abandoned). If missing, re-run build.sh switch.

commands.name: node
commands.fix: Installed by flake.nix environment.packages = [ pkgsUnstable.nodejs_22 ] (>=22.12 required by vite 8 et al).
